flags.description: Outside assistants reach a team's tools at the MCP address (/mcp/{env}/{team}).
flags.name: mcp_gateway

flags.description: Agents with more tools than OPS_TOOL_SEARCH_ABOVE search for the one they need.
flags.name: tool_search

flags.description: Each team keeps the plugin version it took and reviews an upgrade before its tools change.
flags.name: plugin_updates

flags.description: The console shows one area at a time, picked from the top bar; off, the sidebar lists every area.
flags.name: area_tabs

role.description: Everything in the team except people and access and the workspace's settings.
role.name: Builder

roles.description: Everything in the team: every area and action. Actions held in the Security team still need a role there.
roles.name: Admin

roles.description: Everything in the team except people and access and the workspace's settings.
roles.name: Builder

roles.description: Reads the team's work and decides its reviews; in the Security team, decides module security reviews.
roles.name: Reviewer

roles.description: Reads the team's work and chats with its agents.
roles.name: Viewer

roles.description: Changes egress, secrets and storage settings for every team, and decides module security reviews.
roles.name: Security admin

roles.description: Chats with the agents published to the team and sees only their own threads; nothing else.
roles.name: Chat user

roles.description: Transfers, closes and restores the workspace. One person holds it, and only a transfer moves it.
roles.name: Owner
